opportunities.title: Build Simple Landscaping CRM
opportunities.description: Simple CRM Brief We require a simple CRM for our landscaping business. The system should be accessible on desktop, iPad and mobile. Essential requirements: 1. Automatically capture enquiries submitted through our Squarespace website. 2. Allow WhatsApp enquiries to be added manually through a quick-entry form. 3. Record customer details, project description, estimated value and expected start date. 4. Allow each lead to be manually rated from 1 to 5 stars. 5. Display opportunities in a visual sales pipeline: New → Contacted → Site Visit → Quoted → Won / Lost. 6. Record a next action and due date against each lead, with reminders for overdue tasks. 7. Integrate with Google Calendar for site visits and appointments. 8. Provide a dashboard showing total open pipeline value, confirmed booking value and outstanding actions. 9. Allow filtering by lead rating, pipeline stage and expected project date. We would prefer an existing low-cost platform such as Airtable or a similar no-code solution rather than bespoke software development. The system should be straightforward to maintain, with minimal ongoing subscription costs. Please provide a fixed-price quotation for initial setup and details of any recurring costs.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40818517, publicado hace 3 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: GBP 250 - 750.

opportunities.title: Facebook Comment Ranking Strategy Expert
opportunities.description: I run a service-based business that gains clients by replying to public posts—mainly in groups and on individual public profiles—where people are already asking for what I offer. Thirty warmed-up Facebook accounts handle the outreach. Right now the workflow is simple: drop the comment, add a couple of quick likes from 0–3 of the other accounts, and move on. Results are mixed. On posts with barely ten comments, mine might sit fifth or be hidden completely. I don’t need code, bot tweaks; I need a clear explanation of how Facebook decides which comments float to the top. The core knowledge I want transferred to me covers: • How comment content, relevance, and threaded replies influence ranking • The weight Facebook gives to early likes, reactions, and other engagement signals • Account-level trust factors, history, and any hidden limits that suppress visibility I am mostly interested in knowledge about shadow marketing. I want to know how use my bots account to make ma commets more viewed I am only looking for someone with proven experience and expertise. I expect anyone who reaches out to provide examples showing they know what they are doing and have completed similar projects in the past.

Agradeceré comentarios en el vídeo o notas dentro del archivo si utilizas atajos o técnicas particulares.

opportunities.title: Pair-Programming AI Booking MVP Leads
opportunities.description: Bids are valid only through our test. Bids without a completed test and its receipt number will not be considered. Test: https://artusihabibot.com/dev-assessment/ Access passphrase: Nazimerd About the project Artusi Ħabibot is a multilingual, chat-first restaurant booking assistant: users find a place, request a table and receive a real confirmation and a reminder. We start on Telegram and will extend to WhatsApp and voice calls. No app download. The goal is a working MVP in a pilot city in Italy. Who we are looking for Two lead engineers who will work together in pair programming and practise test-driven development (failing test first, then code, then refactor). Tests are how we agree scope and acceptance, so management stays light. No one approves their own work: each lead reviews the other’s evidence. Main stack: Python (aiogram, async), PostgreSQL, LLMs via OpenRouter or open models, telephony and speech-to-text/text-to-speech for voice. Phases and budget (per person) Phase 1 – Plan validation: USD 50. Complete the plan together and confirm the development scope, the infrastructure, telephony and AI costs, and a realistic marketing and user-acquisition hypothesis. Phase 2 – Build: USD 200, starting in December. Only if the Phase 1 plan is validated. Phase 3 – Pilot: USD 200, starting in January. Fixed payments go through Freelancer.com milestones, released for accepted and tested deliverables. Beyond the fixed budget, compensation is a revenue fee per confirmed booking with a cap, or shares for those who want to stay in the project long term. How to apply Open the test, enter the passphrase above and your email, and type the 6-digit code you receive. Answer four technical challenges and a cost plan for calls and AI (sourced unit prices, monthly totals, cost per booking), plus your motivation, proposed economics and an AI-use declaration. Drafts are saved automatically. Submit once and quote your receipt number (HB-…) in your bid, together with your weekly availability for pairing and your time zone. The evaluation criteria and weights are visible inside the test before you answer. Important: the name on your Freelancer.com profile and the name on the email account you use for the test must match. Mismatching identities will be reported to Freelancer.com.

opportunities.title: App móvil venta productos
opportunities.description: Quiero lanzar una aplicación móvil que me permita vender productos físicos de forma sencilla y segura. La idea es que el usuario pueda explorar un catálogo, añadir artículos al carrito, pagar dentro de la app y luego hacer seguimiento de su pedido. Me muevo con rapidez y disfruto de la tecnología, por lo que busco un desarrollo limpio, escalable y bien documentado. Funcionalidades clave • Catálogo con fotos, descripciones y stock en tiempo real • Carrito de compras y proceso de checkout optimizado • Pasarela de pago segura (tarjeta y, si es posible, billeteras digitales) • Notificaciones push para confirmar pedidos y actualizaciones de envío • Panel de administración para gestionar inventario, precios y promociones • Módulo de seguimiento de pedidos con número de guía • Estadísticas básicas de ventas y clientes Alcance técnico Prefiero una solución multiplataforma (Flutter o React Native) para publicar tanto en iOS como en Android, pero acepto propuestas nativas si justifican ventajas claras. El código debe quedar en un repositorio Git, acompañado de instrucciones de despliegue y un breve manual de usuario interno. Entregables 1. Código fuente completo y documentado 2. Build firmada lista para App Store y Google Play 3. Panel de administración funcional (puede ser web) 4. Archivo de configuración y guía de instalación Valoro la comunicación ágil, los commits frecuentes y la posibilidad de añadir funciones extra más adelante (por ejemplo, cupones o programa de fidelidad). Si tienes experiencia en e-commerce móvil y pasarelas de pago, será un plus importante.

opportunities.title: No-Code Web Scraping Automation Bot -- 2
opportunities.description: Project Overview: I need a skilled freelancer to build a no‑code browser automation bot using any software or coding. The bot will: Read a list of dates (from Google Sheets or CSV) Loop through each date Navigate to a specific website or search URL Search the correct Name from the list in Sheets or CSV Scroll if needed and find the date into a search field or URL that matches Find and click the matching date in the search results Extract relevant data from the resulting page using another coding or software and if possible use "Instant Data Scraper" or another software if needed. Each column on data extracted needs to be in horizontal mode, e.g. numbers going from 1 to 8 down in sheets or csv need to be in 1 to 8 across and horizontally. Save the results back into a spreadsheet (CSV or Google Sheets) Budget from Manager is low. Responsibilities: Read dates from a sheet or CSV Loop through each date Go to URL/search, insert current date Click the link that matches the date Scrape specific fields (e.g., price, details, etc.) Write results back to sheet or CSV Use selectors intelligently (dynamic variables) Add wait steps to ensure pages load Setup reliable extraction and debugging

opportunities.title: Descompilar y recompilar juego Gamebryo
opportunities.description: Cuento con el ejecutable original de un juego de mi infancia basado en Gamebryo con DirectX 9. Antes de empezar a retocar textos, gráficos o mecánicas, lo primero que necesito es un flujo estable de ingeniería inversa: obtener el código fuente legible, reorganizarlo en un proyecto que compile sin errores y generar un nuevo .exe funcional que se comporte exactamente igual que el original. Proporciono el .exe y los recursos actuales; también tengo identificadas varias DLL asociadas al motor. El objetivo inicial es: • Descompilar completamente el binario y cualquier librería vinculada • Reestructurar y documentar el proyecto de modo que pueda abrirse y compilarse en un entorno moderno (Visual Studio + SDK DirectX 9, por ejemplo) • Entregar un build reproducible con instrucciones paso a paso y las herramientas empleadas Cuando el re-ensamblado sea fiable, planeo avanzar hacia la localización de textos y ajustes ligeros, por lo que valoraré un código claro, comentarios donde se descubran offsets críticos y scripts que automaticen el proceso. Aprecio experiencia previa con Gamebryo, IDA Pro, Ghidra o herramientas similares, pero lo importante es obtener un proyecto mantenible y una compilación idéntica al ejecutable original.

opportunities.title: Roblox Multiplayer Kart Battle Game
opportunities.description: Hi, I want to develop a complete 3D multiplayer kart battle game on Roblox, inspired by the gameplay style of Smash Karts. I am looking for a fully functional, polished and monetizable Roblox game, not just a basic prototype. ### 1. Core Gameplay - Players drive customizable karts in an arena. - Multiplayer battles with real players. - Each match should support approximately 8–12 players. - Players collect random weapons and power-ups from boxes around the map. - Players attack opponents using different weapons. - Players earn kills, points and rewards. - Match timer, scoreboard and winner announcement. ### 2. Weapons and Power-ups Include multiple weapons, such as: - Rockets - Machine guns - Bombs - Mines - Homing missiles - Speed boosts - Shield protection - Special abilities Each weapon should have unique effects, animations and damage mechanics. ### 3. Maps and Arenas I want at least 3 unique battle arenas at launch. Examples: - Desert Arena - Neon City Arena - Tropical Island Arena Each map should have obstacles, ramps, weapon pickup locations and different environments. ### 4. Kart System - Multiple kart designs. - Smooth driving controls. - Acceleration, braking and drifting. - Kart customization. - Different kart skins. - Responsive mobile and PC controls. ### 5. Multiplayer and Matchmaking - Multiplayer matchmaking. - Waiting lobby. - Automatic match starting. - Player respawning. - Match results. - Leaderboards. - Proper server-side validation to prevent exploits. ### 6. Progression and Monetization - Coins and XP. - Daily rewards. - Missions and achievements. - Kart skins and customization. - Game passes. - Developer products. - Premium cosmetic items. The game must support Roblox's monetization system. ### 7. UI/UX I want a modern, polished interface: - Main menu. - Play button. - Garage. - Shop. - Inventory. - Missions. - Settings. - Matchmaking screen. - In-game scoreboard. - Results screen. ### 8. Technical Requirements - Entire game must be developed in Roblox Studio. - Clean and organized Luau scripts. - Proper server-client architecture. - DataStore saving system. - Optimized for PC, mobile and tablet. - No major bugs or broken features. - Proper testing before delivery. ### 9. Deliverables I require: 1. Complete playable Roblox game. 2. Full Roblox Studio project/source files. 3. All scripts and assets used. 4. Working multiplayer systems. 5. Documentation for important systems. 6. Testing and bug fixing. 7. Assistance with publishing the game. ### Before Starting, Please Tell Me: 1. Your total development cost. 2. Estimated delivery time. 3. Examples of multiplayer Roblox games you have developed. 4. Whether you will create custom 3D assets. 5. Whether the quoted price includes all three maps and all requested systems. 6. Whether you provide post-delivery bug support. Please provide a detailed quotation with milestones and payment terms. I want a high-quality, complete game that is ready for public release.

opportunities.title: Detailed 3D Front-Discharge Mixer
opportunities.description: I have a full set of reference photos of a front-discharge concrete mixer and I need them translated into a production-ready 3D asset. The goal is a fully detailed model—cab, wheels, drum, chute, visible hydraulics, ladders, even the hose couplings—so that I can generate high-resolution marketing imagery straight from the file. The final piece has to look great under studio lighting and hold up to close-up camera angles, which means clean topology, correct real-world scale, and PBR materials that mimic painted steel, rubber, glass, and galvanised fittings. I’m comfortable with any mainstream modelling tool (Blender, 3ds Max, Maya, SolidWorks) as long as the finished work can be exported to STL or 3MF and keeps the material assignments intact. Deliverables • One fully detailed, watertight 3D model of the mixer • Texture set (PBR, 4-8K) organised by material type • Two or three preset studio scenes so I can instantly render hero shots Acceptance criteria • No non-manifold geometry or flipped normals • Parts logically grouped and named for easy selection • Model opens at the correct scale (in metres) in Blender/Max without tweaks • Renders match or exceed photo clarity when placed in a simple three-point light rig Share any portfolio examples of heavy-equipment modelling when you reply; that will help me jump straight into awarding the project. I will be 3D Printing this on the FlashForge AD5X. I can do it in pieces if need be that need to be glued and constructed.

opportunities.title: B2B Appointment Setter for US Agencies
opportunities.description: We are hiring a freelancer to deliver four qualified buyer meetings with founders and owners of marketing and lead generation agencies. The scope is fixed: four qualified meetings, delivered within 10-12 days of start. If the work is delivered well, we will discuss ongoing hourly work for requirements that come up later. Target prospects Founder, owner, managing director, partner, or head of operations Agencies in performance marketing, PPC, SEO, lead generation, growth marketing, or marketing operations Based in the USA, with 1 to 15 employees and 3 to 20 active clients Open to outsourcing technical work across borders or through a white-label partner, with a preference for partners in India What a qualified meeting means Each meeting must pass our BANT+ check before it is booked: Budget: The agency has paying clients and can fund outsourced technical work on an hourly or project basis. Authority: The attendee is the founder, owner, managing director, partner, or head of operations, not a gatekeeper. Need: The agency has a current client-related technical requirement, such as automation, AI agents, integrations, or custom workflows, and limited in-house development capacity. Openness: The agency is willing to outsource, including cross-border or white-label work. Timeline: The agency can realistically start paid work. What you will do Source and contact prospects through email, LinkedIn, and phone, following the outreach plan we provide Qualify each prospect against the BANT+ criteria Book meetings on our calendar, with confirmation and reminder messages Send a short briefing note for each meeting covering the agency, contact, current requirements, and expected start timeline

opportunities.title: Guía y tutoría MATLAB-EEGLAB
opportunities.description: Nunca he usado MATLAB, pero necesito ejecutar EEGLAB para analizar registros de EEG que ya tengo en formato EDF/BDF. Busco a alguien que primero investigue y documente cómo integrar correctamente MATLAB con EEGLAB en mi sistema y, después, me enseñe a utilizar el flujo de trabajo básico para: • Instalar y configurar MATLAB, las toolboxes necesarias y la versión más estable de EEGLAB. • Importar archivos EDF/BDF a EEGLAB sin pérdida de canales ni metadatos. • Aplicar pasos de limpieza esenciales (filtros, detección/rechazo de artefactos, ICA) sobre datos previamente adquiridos. • Ejecutar análisis estándar (marcar eventos, crear epochs, calcular ERPs o espectros de potencia) con scripts reproducibles. • Guardar y exportar resultados y gráficos para futuras publicaciones. Quiero un paquete que incluya: – Un documento paso a paso con capturas y fragmentos de código comentado. – Una breve guía de conceptos básicos de MATLAB orientados a EEGLAB (funciones, rutas, variables, scripts). – Al menos dos sesiones en línea en vivo donde revisemos la instalación y corramos un ejemplo real con mis datos. – Respuestas a preguntas posteriores por escrito mientras practico. Valoraré que la explicación sea clara para principiantes y que el código quede listo para escalar a análisis más complejos en el futuro.

opportunities.title: Earring Jewelry CAD Designer Needed
opportunities.description: I run a small line of sterling-silver jewelry and I’m looking for a reliable CAD partner who truly understands how pieces move from screen to casting bench. Most of the work in my queue is earrings—mainly eng-clasp and classic stud styles—featuring large lab-grown sapphires (round, oval, pear, and marquise). Here’s how we’ll work together: I supply precise stone measurements and a visual reference for the overall look; you decide the exact prong size, wall thickness, seat depth, and any extra structural bracing so the model survives casting and sets cleanly in 925 silver. An eye for real-world tolerances is critical—I’m after someone who thinks like a bench jeweler, not just a 3D artist. Typical payout for a straightforward design is in the $10–20 range. When a design is approved, I’ll need: • an editable Rhino 3DM file • a production-ready STL ready for print or CAM If this sounds like a fit, send over a few samples of past jewelry CAD work—finished renders, screenshots, or photos of cast pieces you’ve designed are all welcome. I review portfolios first, then we can move directly into the next earring assignment.

opportunities.title: Ice Cream Cafe Layout & Equipment
opportunities.description: I’m getting ready to build a medium-sized ice cream cafe—enough room for a service counter and a handful of tables—and I need a detailed layout and equipment plan that brings the space to life. Our menu is built around classic scoops and elaborate sundaes, so the floor plan has to guide guests smoothly from the entrance to the dipping cabinet, while keeping prep, storage and cleaning areas efficient for staff. You’ll start with my rough measurements and concept sketches, then translate them into a professional layout that a contractor and health inspector can read without questions. Think clear customer flow, logical placement of dipping cabinets, topping stations, POS, and a compact seating zone that still feels inviting. Behind the counter we’ll need room for freezers, refrigerated prep, dry storage, sink stations and all plumbing/electrical rough-ins. Please include: • Scaled floor plan (AutoCAD, SketchUp or similar) showing front- and back-of-house zones • Reflected ceiling or equipment power plan noting utilities for each appliance • Comprehensive equipment schedule with model suggestions, dimensions and spec sheet links • 3-D visual or mood board to illustrate customer experience (optional but preferred) I’ll provide local code notes, brand colours and inspiration photos once we start. If you’ve laid out cafés, dessert bars or quick-service spaces before, I’d love to see those samples. Let’s craft a shop that scoops fast, serves beautiful sundaes and keeps customers coming back for more.

opportunities.title: CAD Design for Car Vent Phone Mount
opportunities.description: Freelance CAD designer needed to turn a client's concept for a car air-vent phone mount into production-ready 3D files for functional 3D printing. This is a small plastic consumer accessory made of several parts that fit together. Full design details (concept drawings and how it works) will be shared only with the awarded freelancer, after signing a short NDA and IP assignment agreement. Please do not ask for them before award. Deliverables: - Complete 3D assembly plus each part modelled separately. - STEP and STL files for every part, print-ready (watertight, correct orientation). - Parametric native CAD source file (Fusion 360, SolidWorks, Onshape or similar) so dimensions can be adjusted after the first test print. - Designed for SLS/MJF printing in PA12 nylon, with engineering tolerances for fitting parts (clearances of about 0.3 to 0.5 mm) and suitable wall thickness. - Short note listing assumptions and dimensions to confirm. Please share relevant CAD experience with mechanical or consumer products, snap-fit or small assemblies, and print-ready design, with examples of past work. In your bid, tell us your price, timeline and CAD software. One round of revisions after the first prototype is expected.

opportunities.title: Smart Wearable Enclosure CAD Redesign
opportunities.description: The current enclosure of my wrist-worn smart device exists as a Fusion 360 assembly, but it still takes too many steps to put together on the bench. Your task is to refine that design so the next revision is straightforward to assemble and friendly to large-scale CNC machining. You will start by reviewing my existing Fusion 360 file, tightening the external form, re-laying internal PCBs, battery and sensors, and adding all mounting, snap-fit or screw bosses needed for a clean mechanical stack-up. My top priority is making the enclosure easier to assemble and manufacture, so every decision—from wall thickness and draft angles to fastener choice—should reflect Design for Manufacturing principles. Once the architecture is locked, I need fully detailed, tolerance-controlled documentation ready for both prototype CNC runs and future production. opportunities.title: Social Media Share / Copy Link Popup
opportunities.description: I need a lightweight, mobile-friendly popup that lets visitors quickly share the current page or copy its URL. The popup should appear when they tap or click a “Share” button I’ll place in my page template. Core requirements • Display recognizable social icons (think Facebook, X, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, Telegram, Email) alongside a clear “Copy Link” option. • One-click copy should place the canonical URL in the user’s clipboard with a visual confirmation (e.g., “Link copied”). • Opening a social icon should pre-populate the post with the correct page title, description, and image pulled from my existing Open Graph data. • Style must match my site’s color palette and respect dark mode if detected. • Code should be vanilla JavaScript (or a small React component if you prefer), clean CSS, and zero external dependencies beyond the sharing URLs themselves. Deliverables 1. Reusable HTML/JS/CSS (or React) component. 2. Brief setup notes so I can drop it into any page type—blog, product, or landing—without breaking layout. 3. A short testing checklist confirming share links, copy function, and responsiveness on major browsers and iOS/Android. If you’ve built similar widgets, a quick demo link or GIF will help me choose faster.

opportunities.title: Long-Term B2B Outreach Operator – n8n / Make + WhatsApp API + Email (India)
opportunities.description: We are VIMA India Business Desk, based in Nagpur. We need a long-term B2B Campaign Operator and automation expert — not a one-time developer. We have working Excel databases of Indian B2B buyers . They are a solid starting point, but incomplete: some records are missing key contact fields and part of the data needs updating and verification. Cleaning, completing and keeping these lists current is part of the job. PHASE 1 (this fixed-price project): data preparation + technical setup + Month 1 of live operations. 1. DATA PREPARATION: audit our existing lists, remove duplicates and invalid records, verify and complete missing contact fields, and set up a repeatable process to keep the database updated. Tell us in your proposal which tools you use for email verification and data enrichment in the Indian market. 2. SETUP: connect email, LinkedIn and WhatsApp Business API into one outreach funnel using n8n or Make. All infrastructure built under VIMA accounts — you operate it, we own it. 3. DAILY OPERATION: load our lists into the system and run campaigns week by week. 4. LEAD ROUTING: filter the noise and route only qualified leads directly to our local manager in Nagpur. 5. DELIVERABILITY AND COMPLIANCE: manage domain warm-up, sending volumes and WhatsApp template approvals so our domains stay out of spam folders and our WhatsApp number stays in good standing. WHAT WE MEASURE IN MONTH 1 - Percentage of records cleaned, verified and enriched - Emails delivered vs. bounced (target bounce rate under 3%) - Open and reply rate per segment - Number of qualified leads routed to our Nagpur manager - Zero domain blacklisting, zero WhatsApp number restrictions TERMS - VIMA pays for all software licences (n8n, Wati, Meta, LinkedIn tools, verification and enrichment tools). - Data preparation and setup must be completed within 15 working days of project start. - If Month 1 meets the targets above, we move you to a permanent monthly retainer. That is the real opportunity here — we want one operator for the long run. - Preference for candidates in or near Nagpur. Remote across India is acceptable. SELECTION PROCESS Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a short PAID test task (48 hours) before we award the project. We pay for the test whether or not we hire you. SCREENING — READ CAREFULLY Generic bids will be ignored. To be considered, start your proposal with the exact phrase: "VIMA Nagpur Operator" Then answer in no more than 4 sentences total: 1. How do you handle opt-in and template approval when messaging a cold B2B list through the WhatsApp Business API? 2. Name one project where you ran an outreach system continuously for 3 or more months, and what reply rate you achieved. Proposals without the phrase, or without both answers, will not be reviewed.

Nuestros alumnos incluyen emprendedores, propietarios de pequeños negocios, profesionales independientes, estudios de belleza, spas y negocios locales que desean aprender a promocionar sus servicios mediante publicidad digital. ¿Qué necesitamos? Una persona que pueda: - Desarrollar un programa de formación desde nivel básico hasta avanzado. - Explicar paso a paso cómo utilizar el Administrador de anuncios de Meta. - Enseñar a crear campañas desde cero para Facebook e Instagram. - Explicar los objetivos de campaña, públicos, segmentación y presupuestos. - Enseñar a configurar anuncios, imágenes, videos y textos publicitarios. - Explicar cómo utilizar WhatsApp como destino para captar clientes. - Enseñar a revisar resultados, métricas y optimizar campañas. - Explicar cómo organizar campañas y administrar diferentes cuentas publicitarias. - Incluir ejemplos prácticos enfocados en pequeños negocios y servicios locales. Requisitos del instructor: - Experiencia demostrable trabajando con Meta Ads. - Capacidad para enseñar de manera clara, organizada y sencilla. - Hablar español. - Contar con equipo adecuado para grabar clases (micrófono, computadora y buena calidad de audio y video). - Tener conocimientos para grabar tutoriales de pantalla y explicar los procedimientos paso a paso. - Poder entregar las clases grabadas y organizadas por módulos. Modalidad del proyecto: Buscamos desarrollar un curso autograbado, dividido en módulos y lecciones, para que los alumnos puedan acceder al contenido y avanzar a su propio ritmo. Si estás interesado, puedes dejarnos en los comentarios tu presupuesto aproximado, una breve descripción de tu experiencia y algún ejemplo de cursos o trabajos que hayas realizado. Posteriormente, nos pondremos en contacto para explicar mejor el proyecto, definir el contenido, la cantidad de módulos, los entregables y acordar una estructura de pago. Le dejamos una pequeña referencia en imagen ¡Esperamos conocer tu propuesta!

opportunities.title: Telugu-English Learning Cartoons Creation
opportunities.description: I’m getting ready to launch “Happy Kids World” and need a creative partner to produce a series of short Telugu-and-English cartoons that help young children aged 5–7 master their letters, numbers, and first words. Each video should balance clear educational moments with the colour and energy that keeps kids giggling, singing along, and—most importantly—learning. You’ll handle the full pipeline—concept, script, voice-over (both languages), animation, sound, and final mastering—so our channel can upload finished episodes on a consistent schedule. The visual style should feel warm, friendly, and easy for children to follow; think bright characters, simple shapes, and lots of repetition that reinforces the alphabet and counting without ever feeling like homework. When you reply, focus on your experience creating educational or children’s animation. Links to completed projects that show bilingual content, early-literacy themes, or a comparable art style will help me see the fit quickly. If you have a preferred workflow or toolset (Toon Boom, Adobe Animate, Blender, After Effects, etc.), mention it so we can align on files and formats from day one. I’m excited to build a long-term collaboration that keeps kids around the world learning, laughing, and playing—starting right here in both Telugu and English.

opportunities.title: Selenium Gmail Email Automation
opportunities.description: I need a concise Selenium-based solution that automatically sends emails from my Gmail / Google Workspace account. The goal is to replicate the exact user flow—log in, compose, attach (when provided), and send—so I can fire off routine messages without manual clicks. Your script should handle authentication securely, respect 2-Step Verification or App Passwords if they are active, and finish by confirming that the “Message sent” toast appears. I’m comfortable running the script in Python, so please structure the code and virtual-env requirements for that stack. Clear inline comments, a short README, and a sample JSON or CSV payload for dynamic subject/body placeholders will make testing easy on my side. I’ll consider the task complete once I can: • Execute a single command that launches the browser, signs in, composes, and sends. • See verification that Gmail accepted the email or receive the sent copy in my inbox. • Swap in my own recipient list and template text without editing core logic. If you rely on additional libraries—Selenium WebDriver, webdriver-manager, dotenv, etc.—note the versions so environments stay in sync.

opportunities.title: Script Python Aviator para Google Sheets
opportunities.description: TÍTULO: Python Script - Coletar Histórico Público Aviator para Google Sheets CATEGORIA: Python / Web Scraping / Google Sheets API ORÇAMENTO: $10 - $50 USD (Vou premiar por $30) DESCRIÇÃO: Preciso de um script em Python simples, código aberto, para coletar histórico público e salvar no Google Sheets. Sem aposta, sem login, sem automação de jogo. O QUE PRECISO (Marco 1): 1. Script em Python (.py) que rode no meu PC (Windows). 2. O script deve ler o histórico público de multiplicadores que aparece na tela (últimas 50 rodadas) a cada 60 segundos. 3. Salvar automaticamente em uma aba chamada Historico_Aviator no Google Sheets com 3 colunas: Data/Hora | Multiplicador | ID da Rodada 4. Não pode duplicar rodadas que já foram salvas. 5. Arquivo README.txt explicando passo a passo como instalar e rodar (pip install, como criar a chave do Google). 6. Vídeo de 2 minutos mostrando o script rodando na sua máquina e atualizando o Sheets. 7. Profissional com experiência comprovada em "bots Aviator" e/ou automações relacionadas a sites de apostas para fornecer orientações profissionais sobre o projeto e sugerir melhorias adicionais. REGRAS OBRIGATÓRIAS: 1. Código 100% aberto e comentado. Não aceito .exe, .apk ou código ofuscado. 2. Não pode fazer login na casa de aposta, não pode clicar em apostar, não pode automatizar aposta. 3. Pagamento SOMENTE por marco dentro do Freelancer. Não pago por WhatsApp, USDT. PRAZO: 3 dias após premiar. PARA SE CANDIDATAR, RESPONDA ISSO NA SUA PROPOSTA (se não responder, ignoro): Qual biblioteca Python você usaria para pegar os dados e por quê? Responda em 2 linhas.

opportunities.title: Full-Stack Developer Needed –Membership Portal & Dashboard Integration (Laravel)
opportunities.description: We are seeking an experienced full-stack developer to design and develop a complete, secure, database-driven membership portal and personalized member dashboard for our website. An existing membership database is available, but the member dashboard and portal must be developed from scratch in Laravel. Project Requirements: 1. Dashboard Design & Development: Design and build a modern, professional, mobile-responsive member dashboard consistent with AAPSCM® branding. 2. Membership Registration: Develop a secure online registration, account activation, and login system for existing members. 3. Member Identity Verification: Integrate the existing membership database to authenticate members using their membership IDs or certificate IDs, with appropriate identity verification. 4. Account & Password Management: Allow verified members to create personal accounts with secure passwords, mandatory password changes every 30 days, and password recovery functionality. 5. Automated Profile Population: Automatically retrieve and display each member's personal information, professional details, membership category, status, and expiration dates from the existing database. 6. Certification Integration: Connect certification records to individual member accounts and automatically display earned certifications, certificate IDs, issue dates, expiration dates, and digital credentials. 7. Dashboard Modules: Develop functional sections for Dashboard Overview, Membership, My Profile, Certifications, Orders, Exams, Training & Learning, Events & Webinars, Chapters & Communities, Resources & Publications, and Account Settings. 8. Administrative Management: Develop an administrative interface for managing member accounts, certifications, membership status, resources, and access permissions. 9. Database Integration & Automation: Integrate existing membership records with the new portal and enable automatic synchronization of relevant member information. 10. Security & Access Control: Implement secure authentication, role-based permissions, member-specific data protection, and appropriate cybersecurity safeguards. 11. Testing & Deployment: Conduct complete system testing, resolve technical issues, deploy the portal, and provide technical documentation. Required Expertise: Full-stack web development, PHP/Laravel or compatible technologies, MySQL, API integration, UI/UX design, database management, and secure membership management systems. Bidders must provide: Examples of similar completed projects, proposed development approach, estimated completion timeline, and a fixed-price quotation. Fee: $2,000 (Maximum deadline - 3-4 weeks)

opportunities.title: Cinematic 3BHK Interior Walkthrough Design
opportunities.description: I’m looking for an original interior design for my 1,883 sq ft, 3BHK apartment in Bengaluru. Propose one distinctive theme that suits the attached floor plan and brings the whole home together. I’d like it to feel warm, spacious and cinematic, with practical materials and lighting for everyday family life. What goes where (as shown on the floor plan) * Entrance and front living room: Welcoming seating for guests. * Kitchen and utility: The builder has agreed to remove the kitchen divider. Design an open kitchen for daily Indian cooking, a two-seat breakfast counter and a practical laundry and drying area. * Former dining area: Keep it open for everyday use. Allow space for a folding table when we host one other family. * Balcony-side family lounge: Our main TV and relaxation area. Keep the route to the balcony clear. * Wood-floored bedroom, bottom right: Master bedroom with wardrobe storage. * Bedroom immediately to the right as you enter, top left on the plan: Daughter’s room with a study area and storage. * Bottom-left room: Home office, Instagram studio and gym. Include a dual-monitor desk, a filming backdrop, space for a tripod and umbrella light, and clear floor space for workouts. * All three bathrooms and the balcony: Include them in the design and walkthrough. The balcony should have seating for two and plants. What to submit: A short explanation of your theme, a furniture layout and a rendered MP4 walkthrough covering every space. Use the attached plan for room proportions and openings. Mark any layout changes you propose. No generative AI. The design, renders and video must come from your own 3D modelling work. Include one screenshot of your model in the design software. Please ask as many questions as you need. I’m happy to answer and share any measurements or details you need.

opportunities.title: Odoo–WhatsApp API Connector
opportunities.description: I need a seamless bridge between my Odoo Online database and the WhatsApp Business API so every customer conversation flows directly into Odoo. The integration must let me: • send and receive one-to-one WhatsApp messages from within Odoo’s Discuss/Live Chat views • trigger automatic WhatsApp notifications when an order is confirmed, shipped, or an invoice is posted and paid • turn any incoming chat into a new CRM lead or a Helpdesk ticket, complete with message history and customer contact details Because I am on Odoo Online, the solution has to work without custom server access—either by relying on Meta’s Cloud API endpoints or routing through a provider like Twilio or 360dialog. If you have a preferred method, outline it along with any webhook or middleware you propose. Deliverables 1. A ready-to-install Odoo Online app or external middleware with clear setup instructions 2. Mapping of order and invoice events to message templates, including placeholders for order number, amount, and tracking link 3. Lead/ticket creation logic with field mapping (name, phone, message body, channel) 4. Short video or screenshots showing the three core flows working end-to-end in my sandbox database 5. Post-deployment support for initial testing and template approval with Meta Acceptance criteria: messages move in real time, no duplicate records are created in Odoo, and outgoing notifications are logged under the relevant order or invoice.

opportunities.title: Hyper-Realistic 3D Character Showcase
opportunities.description: I’m producing a hyper-realistic 3D short movie designed purely as a cinematic visual showcase. The entire narrative will orbit around a single, lifelike human character whose facial nuance, skin detail, and natural movement must stand up to extreme close-ups and dramatic lighting. Scope of work • Complete character pipeline—sculpting, retopology, texturing (Substance Painter or equivalent), hair & groom, clothing simulation, and photoreal shading. • Full animation pass: subtle idle motions through to expressive facial performance, motion-captured or key-framed as you see fit, but it must feel entirely natural. • Cinematic lighting, depth-of-field work, and physically accurate rendering in either Unreal Engine 5, Blender Cycles, Arnold, or another production-grade renderer that you prefer. • Final edit and color-grade delivered as a short film (under a few minutes) in 4K, along with all project files. Acceptance criteria 1. Skin pores, micro-details, and eye shaders remain crisp at 4K close-ups. 2. Cloth and hair react believably to subtle movements and simulated wind. 3. Lighting, lens choices, and camera moves convey a polished, theatrical mood. 4. Final render is free of flicker, noise, or geometry pops. Share any relevant reels or stills that prove your strength with hyper-realistic human work, and briefly outline the tools you intend to use so I know the pipeline you’re most comfortable with. Let’s push visual fidelity as far as current tools allow.

opportunities.title: Bilingual L1 Support Agent
opportunities.description: Serás mi punto de contacto de nivel 1 para atender a colaboradores en toda Latinoamérica de forma remota a través de chat, correo y, cuando haga falta, llamadas breves. Las conversaciones se darán tanto en español como en inglés, por lo que necesito que puedas cambiar de idioma con soltura según el usuario. Tipo de consultas La mayoría de los tickets giran en torno a dudas sobre el uso de nuestras propias herramientas y procesos internos. Esto incluye guiar al usuario paso a paso, compartir pantallazos o enlaces a la base de conocimiento y dejar registro claro en el sistema de tickets. Cuando el problema exceda tu alcance de L1, simplemente tomarás los datos, documentarás lo hecho y lo escalarás. Entorno técnico Trabajamos principalmente con Microsoft 365: Outlook, Teams y las aplicaciones de Office en la nube. Necesito que ya las manejes o aprendas rápidamente sus configuraciones básicas, permisos y paneles de administración más comunes. El acceso remoto y el sistema de tickets te los proporcionaré el primer día junto con un recorrido por nuestra documentación interna. Entregables • Resolver o escalar cada ticket siguiendo el SLA acordado. • Registrar notas claras y completas en la plataforma de soporte. • Proponer mejoras o artículos cortos para la base de conocimiento cuando detectes preguntas repetidas. Si dominas la comunicación bilingüe, te mueves con soltura en Microsoft 365 y disfrutas de ayudar a usuarios a entender herramientas y procesos, avísame y coordinamos una breve entrevista técnica.

opportunities.title: Character workout Animation
opportunities.description: I need a short, lively 3D clip that brings a playful cartoon character to life. The sequence is simple: the character enters, walks a few steps, bursts into a fun dance, finishes with a quick fighting pose, and exits. No dialogue—just energetic, exaggerated body language with classic squash-and-stretch timing. You’ll receive a model sheet, reference beats, and a rough storyboard. If you have a suitable rig, great; otherwise please rig the mesh I supply. Blender or Maya is fine as long as the final scene and assets open cleanly on my end. Deliverables • Rigged character file (Blender . blend or Maya . mb) • 15–20-second animation clip (source scene + 1080p MP4 render with alpha) • One revision pass after I review the first draft Acceptance criteria • Silhouette reads clearly in every key pose • No foot sliding or intersecting geometry • Colors and lighting match the reference palette Keep polycount moderate for web/social use and ensure all textures are original or royalty-free. Let me know your usual turnaround and link me to at least one previous piece that showcases a strong walk, dance, or fight cycle. I’m ready to get started as soon as I see work that matches the vibe I’m after.

opportunities.title: Unreal Engine Digital Twin Artist
opportunities.description: We are seeking a senior 3D artist/digital generalist with demonstrable experience in Unreal Engine 5, MetaHuman (or Character Creator), and AI-assisted facial animation. The role involves developing a hyper-realistic virtual artist—a "digital twin"—for a professional music project focused on bachata and Latin music. Phase 1 of the project includes the following key deliverables: 1. Creation and rigging of a hyper-realistic male digital twin: The character must be 6 feet tall and feature a cinematic, lifelike human aesthetic—based on reference photos provided by the client—avoiding any anime or fantasy-style elements. 2. Setup of a lip-sync and facial expression capture pipeline: Implementation of tools such as Audio2Face, Live Link Face, or similar solutions is required to ensure the character can sing and gesture in Spanish with complete naturalness and emotional realism. 3. Development or adaptation of a photorealistic virtual environment: Creation of an initial virtual setting—such as a recording studio or radio booth—that complements the project's aesthetic. Mandatory requirements for applicants: - Submission of a portfolio or case studies demonstrating experience in creating hyper-realistic human faces and lip-syncing. - Availability to complete a paid test milestone—a short, 5–10 second render validating the face and lip movement—prior to the full production of six music videos. - Ability to maintain fluid communication in Spanish, working toward clear objectives and defined deliverables.

opportunities.title: 5-inch Human Figure 3D Model
opportunities.description: I have a single reference photo of a person and I need it turned into a 5-inch 3D printable figure. The finished file must capture a highly realistic likeness with fine surface detail, and the full-body pose and proportions must match the photo exactly. Please sculpt, retopologize, and deliver a watertight file ready for FDM or SLA printing (STL or OBJ preferred). Keep wall thicknesses and overhangs print-friendly for a figure that will scale to 5 inches tall without losing detail. I will provide the image once we start; feel free to ask for any extra angles you might need before sculpting. When you send the final file I’ll run a quick mesh integrity check and slice preview—once it passes without errors, the job is complete.

opportunities.title: App Gestión Documental Integral -- 2
opportunities.description: Necesito desarrollar una aplicación empresarial que centralice toda la gestión documental y los procesos de atención al cliente de una distribuidora eléctrica. El primer hito debe ser un módulo de Atención al Cliente y Call Center totalmente operativo. Prioridad inicial • Registrar solicitudes, quejas y reclamos en tiempo real. • Consultar de inmediato el historial del cliente con sus contratos y pagos. • Asignar cada caso a un agente y hacerle seguimiento hasta su cierre, con alertas de estatus. Al completarse ese módulo, la misma plataforma deberá abarcar: – Gestión y archivo digital de contratos, expedientes y documentos legales. – Organización de facturas, recibos y comprobantes de pago. – Control de informes técnicos, órdenes de trabajo y planos. – Cobros en cajas, conciliación de pagos y reportes. – Paneles internos de reportes y métricas operativas. Requiero código fuente bien documentado, base de datos estructurada para búsqueda ágil y una interfaz web responsive (framework a tu elección mientras garantice escalabilidad y buenas prácticas). Valoro integraciones estándar (REST, OAuth) y un flujo de despliegue que permita pruebas continuas. Indica tu experiencia en proyectos similares y la metodología que aplicarías para entregarme primero el módulo de atención y luego el resto de la solución.

opportunities.title: Diseño Integral de Interiores y Exteriores para Tienda de Salud y B...
opportunities.description: Se busca un profesional para el diseño integral de interiores y exteriores de una nueva tienda de salud nutricional y bienestar, llamada Bali. El espacio a diseñar tiene una superficie de entre 25 y 35 m2. Es fundamental que el diseño incorpore y refleje los colores de marca existentes y el logotipo de la tienda, que será proporcionado. Para el diseño interior, se requiere una distribución funcional y atractiva que contemple las siguientes áreas clave: - Zonas de exhibición y asesoría para productos. - Sección dedicada a salud femenina. - ÁRea para productos y estrategias de control de obesidad. - Espacio para suplementación deportiva. - Zona específica para suplementación orientada al control de la depresión y la ansiedad. La tienda se enfocará en ofrecer marcas originales y productos respaldados por investigación científica comprobada, así como la mejor asesoría a los clientes. El diseño debe transmitir esta filosofía de calidad, confianza y bienestar, creando un ambiente acogedor y profesional. Se espera una propuesta que optimice el espacio disponible y cree una experiencia de compra única para los clientes. Categoría: Ingeniería y Arquitectura Subcategoría: Diseño de interiores Tamaño del proyecto: Pequeño

opportunities.title: Servicios Legales Integrales para Protección de Contenido Digital y...
opportunities.description: Se busca un profesional o despacho legal especializado para gestionar de principio a fin la protección de contenido digital y la lucha contra la piratería de cursos online de nuestros clientes. El alcance del proyecto incluye: - Gestión de requerimientos y acciones de retirada de tiendas y sitios web que distribuyen o regalan cursos de forma ilegal. Esto implica contactar al infractor, al proveedor de alojamiento, al registrador del dominio, a Cloudflare y a la pasarela de pago. - Eliminación de contenido distribuido ilegalmente en canales y grupos de Telegram, así como en perfiles de redes sociales. - Obligar a la retirada de contenido específico de nuestros clientes, incluso si la web o el canal infractor permanece activo. - Iniciación de acciones legales, tanto por vía penal como civil, contra aquellos que no cumplan con las solicitudes de retirada o reincidan, en el país donde se encuentren, llevando el caso hasta su resolución final. El cliente proporcionará la detección de las infracciones, las pruebas necesarias y los informes técnicos. El profesional legal se encargará de la firma de documentos, la presión legal y la interposición de denuncias. Requisitos imprescindibles. Abogado/a colegiado en ejercicio (indica país, colegio y número). Práctica real en propiedad intelectual o delitos informáticos: cuéntanos dos casos de retirada o denuncia y cómo acabaron. Capacidad para denunciar fuera de tu país, con tu propia red de corresponsales. Tenemos casos abiertos ahora mismo en Perú, México y Colombia. No buscamos servicios de envío masivo de avisos dmca ni perfiles de cumplimiento normativo o rgpd sin práctica en propiedad intelectual. Cómo trabajaremos. Relación estable: cuota mensual para las retiradas y honorarios aparte por cada denuncia. Indica tu tarifa para cada parte y en cuánto tiempo mandarías el primer requerimiento. Para descartar respuestas automáticas, empieza tu propuesta contándonos el último sitio o canal pirata que conseguiste cerrar. Categoría: Legal Tiempo requerido: De 5 a 20 horas

opportunities.title: Captador/a de propietarios en Madrid – gestión de alquileres (remot...
opportunities.description: H50 HOMES, una empresa española en expansión especializada en la gestión de alquileres, busca un/a captador/a de propietarios para unirse a su equipo de forma remota. El objetivo principal es identificar y contactar a propietarios particulares en Madrid para incorporar sus propiedades a la cartera de la empresa. Se busca una persona responsable, organizada y orientada a resultados, con el fin de establecer una relación de colaboración estable y a largo plazo. Funciones principales: - Búsqueda activa de propietarios particulares a través de portales inmobiliarios como Idealista, Fotocasa y otros. - Creación y mantenimiento de una base de datos de propietarios potenciales, incluyendo el filtrado de anuncios relevantes. - Realización del primer contacto con los propietarios mediante llamadas telefónicas, WhatsApp o mensajería de los portales, utilizando el argumentario proporcionado por la empresa. - Seguimiento de los propietarios interesados hasta que sean transferidos a la Dirección para el cierre del acuerdo. - Registro detallado de todos los contactos y oportunidades generadas, así como la elaboración de informes regulares sobre los resultados obtenidos. Condiciones del proyecto: - Modalidad 100% remota. - Dedicación de 6 horas diarias, de lunes a viernes, preferiblemente en horario partido (3 horas por la mañana y 3 horas por la tarde). - Las franjas horarias más efectivas para realizar llamadas son a partir de las 10:30 am y las 5:00 pm (hora de españa). - Se requiere compatibilidad horaria con España. Es posible compaginar con otros proyectos siempre que se cubra el horario íntegramente. Retribución: - Un fijo mensual de 300 EUR. - Un variable de 75 EUR por cada piso captado e incorporado a la cartera (una vez que el propietario firma el contrato de gestión). - Posibilidad de un BONUS adicional por volumen mensual. - El pago se realizará mensualmente mediante factura o documento de cobro como profesional independiente. - Existe la posibilidad de ampliar las horas y la retribución en función de los resultados obtenidos. Requisitos del perfil: - Español nativo o con un nivel muy alto, con excelente dicción y claridad al hablar. - Experiencia previa demostrable en ventas, teleoperación, captación de clientes o atención al cliente. - Comodidad y soltura en la realización de llamadas comerciales. - Manejo fluido de herramientas como Google Sheets/Excel, WhatsApp y correo electrónico. - Disponibilidad estable y capacidad para emitir factura en su país de residencia. - Se valorará positivamente la experiencia en llamadas en frío, conocimiento del sector inmobiliario, uso de Idealista, experiencia con clientes españoles y manejo de Crm. al postularte, cuéntanos tu experiencia, un ejemplo concreto de captación o llamadas en frío con su resultado, tu país y ciudad, tu disponibilidad y por qué buscas un proyecto a largo plazo. Categoría: Marketing Digital y Ventas Subcategoría: Televentas Tiempo requerido: Más de 20 horas

Se busca una persona responsable, organizada y orientada a resultados, con el fin de establecer una relación de colaboración estable y a largo plazo. Funciones principales: - Búsqueda activa de propietarios particulares a través de portales inmobiliarios como Idealista, Fotocasa y otros. - Creación y mantenimiento de una base de datos de propietarios potenciales, incluyendo el filtrado de anuncios relevantes. - Realización del primer contacto con los propietarios mediante llamadas telefónicas, WhatsApp o mensajería de los portales, utilizando el argumentario proporcionado por la empresa. - Seguimiento de los propietarios interesados hasta que sean transferidos a la Dirección para el cierre del acuerdo. - Registro detallado de todos los contactos y oportunidades generadas, así como la elaboración de informes regulares sobre los resultados obtenidos. Condiciones del proyecto: - Modalidad 100% remota. - Dedicación de 6 horas diarias, de lunes a viernes, preferiblemente en horario partido (3 horas por la mañana y 3 horas por la tarde). - Las franjas horarias más efectivas para realizar llamadas son a partir de las 10:30 am y las 5:00 pm (hora de españa). - Se requiere compatibilidad horaria con España. Es posible compaginar con otros proyectos siempre que se cubra el horario íntegramente. Retribución: - Un fijo mensual de 300 EUR. - Un variable de 75 EUR por cada piso captado e incorporado a la cartera (una vez que el propietario firma el contrato de gestión). - Posibilidad de un BONUS adicional por volumen mensual. - El pago se realizará mensualmente mediante factura o documento de cobro como profesional independiente. - Existe la posibilidad de ampliar las horas y la retribución en función de los resultados obtenidos. Requisitos del perfil: - Español nativo o con un nivel muy alto, con excelente dicción y claridad al hablar. - Experiencia previa demostrable en ventas, teleoperación, captación de clientes o atención al cliente. - Comodidad y soltura en la realización de llamadas comerciales. - Manejo fluido de herramientas como Google Sheets/Excel, WhatsApp y correo electrónico. - Disponibilidad estable y capacidad para emitir factura en su país de residencia. - Se valorará positivamente la experiencia en llamadas en frío, conocimiento del sector inmobiliario, uso de Idealista, experiencia con clientes españoles y manejo de Crm. al postularte, cuéntanos tu experiencia, un ejemplo concreto de captación o llamadas en frío con su resultado, tu país y ciudad, tu disponibilidad y por qué buscas un proyecto a largo plazo. Categoría: Marketing Digital y Ventas Subcategoría: Televentas Tiempo requerido: Más de 20 horas"

Se trata de venta de espacios publicitarios web y campañas a proveedores de software. Adicionalmente venta de servicios de consultoria (muy básicos). No se requiere experiencia.
